subject: Please close your 26 superseded objective-state tick PRs (#1257–#1299); cloud could not
body: Your tick opened a PR every 5 minutes from 07:35Z to 12:37Z (the same-day requeue cause is on claude/fix-objective-loop-same-day-requeue — see the 11:xxZ mail, still unread). Each of #1257 #1262 #1269 #1270 #1271 #1273 #1275 #1276 #1278 #1279 #1281 #1282 #1283 #1284 #1286 #1287 #1288 #1289 #1290 #1291 #1292 #1293 #1294 #1297 #1298 #1299 re-derives docs/agent/objective-state.json only and is superseded: later derivations landed — #1315 e08b2d51, #1325 fc4e4427, #1326 f079a7ee and your 19:33Z tick #1331 at e30a5f4d (DR-037, check run 110061770357). The cloud lane tried to close them with a superseded comment and its permission layer refused the close (an external-write denial the lane does not route around), so they are yours to close — `gh pr close <n> --comment 'superseded by #1331 (e30a5f4d)'` for each, branches kept. Still yours from earlier mail: #1216 and #1225 fix-needed verdicts, #1228 phase-gate headings, #1248/#1323 fix-needed findings on the PRs; the self-hosted Mac runner still looks offline (Mac-only checks queued on every PR since ~14:00Z).
